feedback: Pre-race review. Nothing has raced for this candidate, so this states no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: five sensors match five weights, outer x-positions are +/-0.07 (inside +/-0.08), y = 0.03, and kp 2.0, ki 0.5, kd 0.2, base_speed 1.5 and last_direction are all inside their limits. It changes one group from the best raced design (iteration 8, score 46.13 at kp 2.5): controller.kp from 2.5 to 2.0, with geometry and all other controller fields unchanged. Iteration 8 showed the oval's line_loss_events rising from 0.6 to 1.7 per run and steering_oscillation rising to 0.17 when base_speed went from 1.4 to 1.5. Iterations 3 to 5 showed kp changes moved the score by under 0.5, so lowering kp is a cheap test of whether the speed-driven oscillation and line loss can be tamed without giving up the oval progress gain from iteration 8. Approve it: the change is a single field, it is valid, and it costs one race run, so the telemetry is more useful than another round of reading numbers. After the race, use the telemetry as follows. (a) If oval line_loss_events falls below 1.7 and steering_oscillation falls below 0.17, while oval progress holds at or above about 0.25 and s-bend and slalom progress stay near 0.042 and 0.037, keep kp 2.0 and consider base_speed 1.6 in a later iteration. (b) If oval progress falls below about 0.25 or s-bend progress falls below 0.0416, under-steering is the limit: restore kp 2.5 (iteration 8). (c) If line_loss_events stays at or above 1.7 with kp 2.0, do not lower speed first; restore kp 2.5 and test kd (for example 0.3) on its own. Change one group of fields per revision.
requested_changes: After the race, if oval line_loss_events falls below iteration 8's 1.7 and oval progress holds at or above about 0.25, keep controller.kp at 2.0 and consider controller.base_speed 1.6 in a later iteration, with all other fields unchanged, citing iteration 8's speed gain.
If oval progress falls below about 0.25 or s-bend progress falls below iteration 8's 0.0416, set controller.kp back to 2.5, since iteration 8 is the best raced design at 46.1311.

If oval line_loss_events stays at or above 1.7 with kp 2.0, keep kp at 2.5 and test controller.kd at 0.3 alone, citing iterations 3 to 5, where gain changes moved the score by under 0.5 but speed changes moved it by more.
